_note: Read by scripts/privacycheck.py. Every file in supabase/ names the phrase on site/src/pages/privacy.astro that tells a reader about it, or why it holds no personal data. Every service names itself; its name must appear on the privacy page. A new table or service joins this file and the privacy page in the same commit (compliance audit, 2026-11-10).

PENDING.sql.exempt: a copy kept on hold, never pasted; the live file it copies is mapped

contributor-reply.sql.phrase: replies about what you sent us

girth.sql.exempt: a trunk measurement on rows already covered; a fact about a tree, not a person

like-counts.sql.exempt: one public number per tree, how many people saved it; names nobody

plus-answers.sql.phrase: answers you give to a question

postbox-needs-an-account.sql.phrase: Suggestions, corrections and votes are made from your account

profile-at-signup.sql.phrase: Every account has a profile from the start

public-profiles.sql.phrase: A public profile can be seen by anybody signed in

reports.sql.phrase: A report stores who reported whom

sightings.sql.phrase: sighting is stored with your account

suggested-people.sql.phrase: We may suggest a public profile

tree-notes.sql.phrase: note you write on a tree

vote-counts.sql.exempt: public totals of votes per tree; names nobody

web-errors.sql.phrase: When a script on this site fails

wishes.sql.phrase: the trees you want to visit

services.Supabase: accounts and everything stored with them
services.Google: Analytics after consent, sign-in with Google, the mail inbox
services.Apple: sign-in with Apple, MetricKit crash reports
services.GitHub: site hosting (GitHub Pages) and the encrypted weekly backup (db-backup.yml)
services.Wikimedia Commons: photographs not yet on our own domain

musts.Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens: GDPR art. 13(2)(d): the right to complain
musts.info@ancienttrees.app: GDPR art. 13(1)(a): who decides and how to reach them
